evals.input: What are the EPF, SOCSO, and EIS rates for a Malaysian employee earning RM 5,000 per month?
expect: EPF employee 11%, employer 13%
SOCSO employee 1.0% (0.5% EI + 0.5% INV), employer 2.25% (1.75% EI + 0.5% INV), capped at RM 6,000 gross wage
EIS employee 0.2%, employer 0.2%, capped at RM 6,000 gross wage
Monthly contribution calculation example uses March 2026 ceilings

evals.input: Walk me through the FWMS payroll processing cycle for March 2026 payroll
expect: Mentions cutoff (25th), calculate (26-28th), validate (29-30th), approve (1st next month), pay (5th next month), report (15th next month)
References PayrollStatus: PENDING → PROCESSED → PAID
Mentions EPF e-submission deadline 15th of next month
Mentions LHDN CP39 deadline 10th of next month
Mentions SOCSO Form 8A/9A deadline 15th of next month
must_not: Omit any major step in the cycle

evals.input: An employee with monthly basic salary of RM 3,000 works 10 hours of normal overtime and 4 hours on a rest day. How is overtime calculated under Malaysian law?
expect: EA S.60A reference
Hourly rate = (Monthly Basic ÷ 26) ÷ 8 = RM 14.42
1.5x for normal overtime (>8h/day or >48h/week)
2x for rest days
3x for public holidays (if applicable)
Max 104 overtime hours per month limit
Example calculation: Normal OT: 10 × 14.42 × 1.5 = RM 216.30, Rest day OT: 4 × 14.42 × 2.0 = RM 115.36, Total: RM 331.66
must_not: Use incorrect multiplier (e.g., 1.0x for rest day)

evals.description: Payroll anomaly detection with severity levels
evals.input: What payroll anomalies should be flagged and at what severity levels?
expect: Critical (block payroll): Negative net pay, Missing EPF deductions for eligible employees, Missing SOCSO contributions, Duplicate payroll runs
High (flag for review): Overtime > 104 hours, Net pay change > 50% month-over-month, Missing PCB for taxable employee, EPF mismatch
Medium (warning only): Unusual allowance > 50% of basic, Missing bank account, Late submission flag
Detection rules for each anomaly type
must_not: Classify critical anomalies as low severity
Omit any of the critical anomalies

evals.description: Decimal precision for monetary values in Prisma queries
evals.input: Write a Prisma query to get the latest payroll for an employee for reporting purposes
expect: Uses Decimal type for netSalary, basicSalary, allowances, deductions
Scoped by tenantId (multi-tenancy compliance)
orderBy periodEnd desc to get latest payroll
Uses findFirst or findMany with proper where clause
Does not parse Decimal to number/float before returning
must_not: Use number or float for salary fields
Use parseInt or parseFloat on Decimal values

evals.input: How are EPF, SOCSO, and EIS handled for foreign workers in Malaysia?
expect: EPF optional for foreign workers (employer/employee can opt-in with 11%/13% rates)
EPF default 0%/0% if not opted in
SOCSO compulsory for all foreign workers (same rates as citizens: 1.0% employee, 2.25% employer, capped at RM 6,000)
EIS compulsory for all foreign workers (0.2% each side, capped at RM 6,000)
PCB: Non-resident foreign workers pay flat 30% on all Malaysian-sourced income
Resident foreign workers (staying >182 days) use progressive PCB rates
must_not: Assume EPF is mandatory for foreign workers

evals.input: What are the current statutory ceilings and caps for payroll deductions in Malaysia?
expect: EPF employee contribution cap: RM 605/month (first RM 5,500 of wage)
SOCSO wage ceiling: RM 6,000/month gross wage
EIS wage ceiling: RM 6,000/month gross wage
Maximum SOCSO contribution: Employee RM 60, Employer RM 135, Total RM 195
Maximum EIS contribution: RM 12 each side
No statutory ceiling for PCB (progressive up to 30%)
must_not: Use RM 5,000 for SOCSO/EIS ceiling (old 2025 value)
Use RM 550 for EPF cap (old 2025 value)

evals.input: What validation checks should be performed before marking payroll as PROCESSED?
expect: All eligible employees have EPF deduction (11% of basic ≤ RM 605)
All eligible employees have SOCSO deduction (1.0% of wage ≤ RM 6,000)
All eligible employees have EIS deduction (0.2% of wage ≤ RM 6,000)
PCB calculated using tax-calculator-enhanced.ts
No negative net pay values
No duplicate runs for same employee/period
Overtime ≤ 104 hours per employee
Employer contributions calculated separately
All monetary values stored as Decimal
tenantId scoped correctly
must_not: Skip EPF validation for eligible employees
Allow negative net pay through validation

notes: Updated for March 2026 statutory rates (EPF 11%/13%, SOCSO/EIS ceiling RM 6,000, EPF cap RM 605). Added foreign worker handling, statutory ceilings, and validation checklist evals.
